name: Rafael Costa
bio:
Rafael's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood in Lisbon, watching Formula 1 races with his father. This passion led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating, he gained valuable experience at a smaller racing outfit, where he honed his skills in wind tunnel operation and data analysis. He joined ROWE Racing two years ago, drawn to their commitment to innovation and their competitive spirit.

At ROWE, Rafael is known for his meticulous approach and his ability to identify subtle aerodynamic improvements. He thrives in the data-driven environment, constantly seeking new ways to optimize vehicle performance. His colleagues appreciate his dedication and his collaborative spirit, even though he prefers to work independently when analyzing complex data sets. He is driven by the pursuit of perfection and believes that even the smallest adjustments can make a significant difference on the track.

Rafael distinguishes himself through his methodical nature and uncanny ability to spot tiny fluctuations in airflow that others might miss. He is also currently teaching himself AI and machine learning to further enhance his understanding of aerodynamic behavior and improve the accuracy of wind tunnel simulations. He is driven to see ROWE succeed, and applies his perfectionism to the task

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Rafael is of average height with a lean build and focused, intense eyes.

quirks: Always brings a thermos of strong espresso to the wind tunnel.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on calibrating the wind tunnel equipment himself before each session.
